summary.intent: Run the GSD `/gsd-plan-phase 70.1` workflow to produce executable PLAN.md files for CipherBox Phase 70.1 (rotation read-plane durability), then continue into `/gsd-execute-phase 70.1` to execute the 13 resulting plans across 7 waves using isolated git worktrees for concurrent plans.
summary.outcome: Phase 70.1 was researched (2 extensions covering the Rust engine.rs twin and desktop FUSE live-wiring), scope-expanded twice per user decisions, planned into 13 PLAN.md files across 7 waves (all gates passed: plan-checker PASSED, decision-coverage 17/17), and CONTEXT/ROADMAP/VALIDATION/STATE were reconciled and committed; execution then began with wave/branch/worktree safety checks confirmed sound before dispatching Wave 1 subagents.

repo: gsd plan-phase decision-coverage gate parses CONTEXT.md `- **D-NN ...**` bullets with only 3 accepted formats (`- **D-NN:** text`, `- **D-NN — title** body`, `- **D-NN: Title.** body`); a single malformed bullet (e.g. period-before-closing-`**` like `- **D-09 (title).**`) causes ALL decisions to fail parsing, not just the offending one — parser code lives in `.claude/gsd-core/bin/lib/decisions.cjs`

gsd commit helper can report `commit_failed` with lint-staged output even when the commit actually succeeded — always verify via `git log`, never blindly retry (matches existing memory feedback-gsd-commit-reword-verify-first)
`gsd_run loop render-hooks plan:pre --raw` emits invalid JSON (literal newlines embedded in fragments) — read the underlying hooks JSON file directly instead of relying on --raw output

the `state.planned-phase` and roadmap `annotate` tools can silently no-op (`updated: []` / `updated: false`) when STATE.md/ROADMAP.md don't match their expected anchor format — always verify the target file changed, don't trust the tool's success echo

execute-phase init computes `branch_name` and there's a known auto-degrade path (#683) where worktree parallelization silently falls back to sequential if HEAD diverged from the worktree fork base — check `worktree.baseRef` and `shouldDegrade` explicitly before assuming worktrees will engage

in this pnpm+cargo monorepo, root `build_command`/`test_command` are effectively empty, so the generic post-merge gate falls back to root `npm test` (= `pnpm --parallel -r run test`, heavy, includes docker-dependent suites, risks 5-min timeout) — use a targeted per-wave gate matching VALIDATION.md instead
worktrees for this repo are gitignored `node_modules`-less — concurrent-plan worktrees must run `pnpm i` (not symlink) before executor work starts

`crates/fuse/src/write_ops/grant_scope.rs` has a documented 'LIVE-WIRING RESIDUAL' stub for `rotate_read_on_scope_exit` (~lines 255-300) that fails closed (EIO) because no production `RotationDeps` impl exists — only test `FakeDeps` does

Rust `RotationDeps`/`engine.rs` twin was structurally behind the TS engine even before this phase: non-recursive `verify_subtree_clean` treating missing-root as clean, 2-field `DirtyFrontierEntry` missing key fields, dirty frontier never folded into fresh/normal walk, `republish_parent` lacks the TS CAS-409 merge-retry

engine's `PublishAttempt::Conflict` needs `remote: PublishedNode` but Rust's `publish_ipns` only returns `current_sequence_number` — a production adapter must do an extra resolve+fetch round-trip to reconcile this shape mismatch (easy to silently break concurrent-add merge)

`SentSharesCache::empty()`/unrefreshed state is fail-open (empty set treated as 'no shares' → skips rotation on shared deletes) — the correct fix keys the check on 'successfully refreshed once', not 'non-empty', or it breaks legitimate zero-share private deletes

code.finding: D-09/D-10 bullets used `- **D-NN (title).** body` (period before closing bold marker) which the decision-coverage parser rejects; fixed by changing to `- **D-NN (title):** body`
rotate_read_on_scope_exit stub returns Err(RotationError::RotateFailed) unconditionally — desktop FUSE rotation fails closed with no live RotationDeps implementor wired in
New file planned (not yet created) to hold the production RotationDeps adapter, sourcing api/owner-keypair/rt from CipherBoxFS (fs.rs:32-37)

workflow: When a subagent is resumed via SendMessage mid-task, instruct it explicitly not to commit so the orchestrator can verify+commit itself — used successfully twice for the researcher extensions

For multi-surface phase scope expansions, thread the decision through CONTEXT.md (decisions), ROADMAP.md (success criteria + source todos), VALIDATION.md (test map), RESEARCH.md (grounding), and any related todo frontmatter together, then commit as one reconciliation pass — keeps the decision-coverage gate and downstream planner/execution consistent

Before spawning parallel worktree-isolated subagents for a wave, check intra-wave `files_modified` overlap across plans as a mandatory safety gate — only dispatch concurrently when file sets are fully disjoint

Route non-blocking secondary scope questions (e.g. ROT-04 desktop grant re-mint) to the planner as a documented deferral-with-rationale rather than interrupting the user a third time, when the ambiguity doesn't gate the plan shape

Prompt-injection heuristic scanners can false-positive on legitimate prose matching patterns like `act as (a|an|the)` in documentation-style content (e.g. ROADMAP phase descriptions) — inspect content directly before treating as a real injection

friction: render-hooks --raw output was invalid JSON, requiring a workaround (reading the file directly) instead of parsing tool output as intended

decision-coverage gate failure only reported '0/15 covered, malformed bullets' without pointing at the specific offending line, requiring manual regex-matching every D-NN bullet against three parser forms to isolate D-09/D-10

state.planned-phase and roadmap annotate tools silently no-op on STATE.md/ROADMAP.md formats that don't match their expected anchors, requiring manual file edits as a fallback and extra verification steps to catch the silent failure
git status quoting bug in orchestrator's own check caused a false 'tree is dirty' read, requiring a second check to correct course

execute-phase init's computed branch_name didn't match the actual current branch on first glance, requiring manual verification that the current branch was a superset (9 commits ahead) before proceeding, to avoid forking a fresh branch off origin/main and stranding 13 plan commits
